about: meta QA 11-25 rows 82 and 119: script paths that point where nothing is, still carried, each with why its fix is not this repo's; shrink only (node .githooks/script-paths.mjs --prune).

findings.why: bake-data-maps.mjs is gone from engine, the SDK and singleplayer alike; reviving this tool needs that API back in the SDK (sharddev's to add).
src/shards.generated.ts is engine's generated shard registry, which a shard repo never has; the bake needs the SDK's shard list instead (an SDK export, sharddev's to add).

findings.finding: scripts/blender/: stray in scripts/ (src/scripts/ is the lean home: move it under src/, or baseline why it stays)
findings.why: The SDK's Blender build (node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/build.sh) reads its manifest at ./scripts/blender/targets.json from the repo root, and its far-reach/roc target builds a model here here; the folder moves under src/ when the SDK's build reads it there (sharddev's change).
